## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18 since its deploy.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions; `list_deployments` showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east) and halted on an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback completed successfully — all three regions are now on v2.3.0.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback. The initial call timed out, but the incident was created successfully.

**Final state:** checkout-api is on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002. Incident INC-0001 is open and tracked.
